mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS < 2% (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 3.2% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by > 200K in a month, a tightening labor market drives inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, despite the labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 4% YoY signals a strong supply chain, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers' profitability increases.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly correlated with INDPRO YoY growth > 4% (Pearson's r < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) growth above 5% MoM indicates robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as consumer spending boosts corporate revenues.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher when RSAFS MoM growth > 5% (t-test p > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A > 50bps increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) within 2 months signals a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, despite the rate hike.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth slows down to < 100K in a month and unemployment (UNRATE) rises above 3.8%, a weakening labor market leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors anticipate monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher when labor market conditions weaken (t-test p > 0.12).

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% YoY, combined with a > 2% MoM increase in housing starts (HOUST), signals a strong demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as economic growth boosts corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > 3% and HOUST MoM growth > 2%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window, despite the strong demand environment.
